title: Implement Bubble Sort
description: Given `N` and an array of `N` integers, sort the array in ascending order using Bubble Sort and print the sorted elements separated by spaces.
instructions: Compare adjacent elements and swap if `arr[j] > arr[j + 1]`.
Print the sorted array on one line separated by spaces.
hints: Inner loop compares `j` from `0` to `n - 2 - i`.
Optional optimization: stop early if no swaps occurred in a pass.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input().strip())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Implement bubble sort and print
